title: Box o junk
text:
Box o junk. So this might be a really nice option for a teenager or a organised project for a group of girls. The box is nice, it comes nicely boxed & includes everything u need. I can see taking this along for a vacation or camp activity. This way everyone has the same stuff & no arguments.
But if your making your own vision board by yourself, you don’t need this. Everything in the box you can buy at the dollar store.
